text:
Azrael, open your black and deep wing,

may its measureless canopy shelter me,

and beneath its beneficent refuge may hide

the incurable sadness of my life.


Azrael, biblical angel, strong angel,

angel of redemption, somber angel,

it is time for you to consecrate to death

my lightless brain: empty altar...


Azrael, my hope is an invalid;

my faith is now setting; dusk has come,

come, now it is necessary that I sleep...

To die..., to sleep..., to sleep...? To dream perhaps!

translation.title: Azrael
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the Hamlet echo at the close while preserving Azrael's devotional address.
